questions.question: Can you describe your leadership role on the Business Intelligence Competency Center hardware and software refresh project at Broadridge, including how you prioritized work, assigned resources, and managed the approximately $1.25M budget?
What was your involvement in the UI fraud detection project, and how did you work with stakeholders to translate fraud-detection needs into reliable technical or reporting solutions?

This role requires building secure, scalable, and performant services. Tell me about a database performance or query-tuning problem you addressed for the Accounts Receivable Collection System or another enterprise system. How did you diagnose and validate the improvement?
Describe an enterprise upgrade, migration, or conversion that you led. What was your rollout plan, how did you manage risk and dependencies, and what was the outcome?
How have you used SQL clustering, Windows clustering, virtualization, or similar infrastructure approaches to improve availability and resilience for enterprise applications?
The role involves leading a full-stack engineering team. How have you mentored multiple technical teams, transferred knowledge, and improved team productivity while maintaining delivery commitments?
What Java development experience have you had, and can you walk through a specific application, component, or technical issue where you used Java?

Describe your experience designing and supporting the architecture for COTS products and in-house applications. How did you make architecture decisions that balanced maintainability, performance, security, and cost?
Give an example of working cross-functionally with development teams, infrastructure teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to deliver an enterprise system or resolve a critical issue.

This position supports a payments platform for small businesses. Based on your experience with accounts receivable, collection systems, fraud detection, and enterprise databases, what reliability, security, and data-integrity considerations would you prioritize when building payment-related services?
